text:
maria: Heads up — customer ACME: users in `finance` lost SSO access after yesterday's RBAC rollout. SSO exchange failing with 'jwe: decrypt failed'. Anyone seen this?

jason: Which IdP/environment? screenshot or logs pls.

maria: Prod eu-west-1. Paste from redwood-auth log:```[2026-03-11T09:12:04Z] auth: oidc_exchange: jwe_decrypt err="kms:Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException" key=alias/redwood-idp-eu region=eu-west-1 svc=scim-worker job=4267``` Also SCIM bulk job 4267 shows repeated 5xx / 400 invalid signature on PATCH group membership.

oliver: We did a KMS alias rotation last week for compliance. SCIM client should use alias but might still have old key-id cached in Vault. If decrypt fails the SSO flow will abort.

maria: Customer reported SCIM PATCH returned `400 invalid signature` and SSO POST assertions were rejected with 500. Sounds related.

jason: Yup — two paths: (A) assertion/encryption uses KMS-wrapped tokens -> decrypt fail => OIDC exchange fails; (B) SCIM uses service account token which may be encrypted with old key -> provisioning fails.

authbot: [automated] KMS rotation completed for alias/redwood-idp-eu at 2026-03-05T22:08Z :information_source:

oliver: Checking Vault: `secret/idp/scim/credentials` metadata shows last_modified 2026-03-05 by infra-bot and `key_id` set to full key-id (oldkeyid) not alias. That explains it.

maria: Confirmed. Vault secret still references `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/oldkeyid`. SCIM worker tries to decrypt service token via KMS key-id and fails.

anne: We need a rollback/mitigation plan. Customer impacted.

jason: Short-term mitigations: 1) Update SCIM client config to use alias (alias/redwood-idp-eu) instead of key-id. 2) Re-encrypt the service token with the new alias. 3) Requeue failed SCIM jobs. If needed, restore alias mapping to oldkeyid for quick rollback.

oliver: I'll push the config patch now. Command I plan to run:```vault write secret/idp/scim/credentials key_id=alias/redwood-idp-eu --force``` then ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/scim-worker -n idp```

maria: After patch I requeued job 4267: logs now: `2026-03-11T09:18:20Z scim: job=4267 status=ok user_updates=14` and SSO exchange shows `oidc_exchange: decrypt ok`.

jason: Verified CloudTrail: KMS:Decrypt successes after config change. No further AccessDenied spikes.

maria: Customer confirmed finance users can login again.

anne: Please open a postmortem with actions: ensure aliases only, forbid storing key-ids, CI check for key-id usage, and add alerting on Decrypt AccessDenied spike. :thumbsup:

oliver: Will create infra PR to: (a) update docs to prefer aliases, (b) add CI lint rejecting key-id patterns, (c) add a telemetry rule in observability.

maria: Filing PM ticket PM-2026-18 to track. Quick notes: root cause = stale key-id stored in Vault for SCIM client after KMS rotation; fix = update to alias + re-encrypt + requeue jobs.

jason: Marking resolved in support ticket. Follow-up: run scan to find any other secrets referencing raw key-ids.

maria: Agreed — I'll run a fast grep across infra secrets and post results. Closing thread once scan is complete.

oliver: TL;DR: KMS alias rotation + stored key-id in Vault => Decrypt AccessDenied -> SSO/SCIM failures. Remediated by switching to alias and re-encrypting.

maria: Thanks all :heart:
